title: godotDEMO
subtitle: A look at the world
note: Working title. A 3D RPG in progress: everything shown here is unfinished and may change.
about: The world starts as one region of open land, 200 by 200 metres, flat and empty, waiting to be built.
Everything in the game is made inside the project, with nothing bought or borrowed.
These pictures are taken in the game itself, with the interface and the map grid switched off.

regions.intro: Where the game begins: flat grass with nothing on it so far.

shots.title: Open land
shots.caption: Flat grass under the day and night cycle. Nothing is built here yet.

extra.title: One place, one day
extra.text: The world runs on a clock, with a sun by day and a moon by night. The same view through one day.
